name: sigenergy
description: Sigenergy SigenStor / hybrid inverters, Modbus protocol V2.x
source: Register definitions from TypQxQ/Sigenergy-Local-Modbus (MIT, (c) 2025 Andrei Ignat), after the Sigenergy Modbus Protocol EN V2.9

registers.name: plant_grid_sensor_status
registers.description: Grid Sensor Status (0: not connected, 1: connected)

registers.name: plant_grid_sensor_active_power
registers.description: Grid Active Power (>0 buy from grid; <0 sell to grid)

registers.name: plant_on_off_grid_status
registers.description: On/Off Grid status (0: ongrid, 1: offgrid(auto), 2: offgrid(manual))

registers.name: plant_grid_sensor_phase_a_active_power
registers.description: Grid sensor Phase A active power

registers.name: plant_grid_sensor_phase_b_active_power
registers.description: Grid sensor Phase B active power

registers.name: plant_grid_sensor_phase_c_active_power
registers.description: Grid sensor Phase C active power

registers.name: plant_grid_sensor_phase_a_reactive_power
registers.description: Grid sensor Phase A reactive power

registers.name: plant_grid_sensor_phase_b_reactive_power
registers.description: Grid sensor Phase B reactive power

registers.name: plant_grid_sensor_phase_c_reactive_power
registers.description: Grid sensor Phase C reactive power

registers.name: plant_ess_soh
registers.description: Battery State of Health (weighted average of all ESS devices)

registers.name: plant_total_generation_of_third_party_inverter

registers.name: plant_current_control_command_value
registers.description: Current control command value (Remote Output Control in Japan)

registers.name: plant_pv_generation_previous_day
registers.description: PV total generation of previous day

registers.name: plant_active_power_fixed_target
registers.description: Active power fixed adjustment target value

registers.name: plant_reactive_power_fixed_target
registers.description: Reactive power fixed adjustment target value. Range: [-60.00 * base value, 60.00 * base value]. Takes effect globally regardless of the EMS operating mode.

registers.name: plant_active_power_percentage_target
registers.description: Active power percentage adjustment target value. Range: [-100.00, 100.00]

registers.name: plant_phase_a_active_power_fixed_target
registers.description: Phase A active power fixed adjustment target value

registers.name: plant_phase_b_active_power_fixed_target
registers.description: Phase B active power fixed adjustment target value

registers.name: plant_phase_c_active_power_fixed_target
registers.description: Phase C active power fixed adjustment target value

registers.name: plant_phase_a_reactive_power_fixed_target
registers.description: Phase A reactive power fixed adjustment target value

registers.name: plant_phase_b_reactive_power_fixed_target
registers.description: Phase B reactive power fixed adjustment target value

registers.name: plant_phase_c_reactive_power_fixed_target
registers.description: Phase C reactive power fixed adjustment target value

registers.name: plant_phase_a_active_power_percentage_target
registers.description: Phase A Active power percentage adjustment target value

registers.name: plant_phase_b_active_power_percentage_target
registers.description: Phase B Active power percentage adjustment target value

registers.name: plant_phase_c_active_power_percentage_target
registers.description: Phase C Active power percentage adjustment target value

registers.name: plant_phase_a_qs_ratio_target
registers.description: Phase A Q/S fixed adjustment target value

registers.name: plant_phase_b_qs_ratio_target
registers.description: Phase B Q/S fixed adjustment target value

registers.name: plant_phase_c_qs_ratio_target
registers.description: Phase C Q/S fixed adjustment target value

registers.name: plant_remote_ems_enable
registers.description: Remote EMS enable (0: disabled 1: enabled). When enabled, the plant's EMS work mode (30003) will switch to remote EMS.

registers.name: plant_independent_phase_power_control_enable
registers.description: Independent phase power control enable (0: disabled 1: enabled)

registers.name: plant_pcs_maximum_export_limitation
registers.description: PCS maximum export limitation. Range: [0, 0xFFFFFFFE]. With value 0xFFFFFFFF, register is not valid. Takes effect globally.

registers.name: plant_pcs_maximum_import_limitation
registers.description: PCS maximum import limitation. Range: [0, 0xFFFFFFFE]. With value 0xFFFFFFFF, register is not valid. Takes effect globally.

registers.name: plant_active_power_regulation_gradient
registers.description: [Grid code] Active power regulation gradient. Range: [0, 5000]

registers.name: plant_lvrt_reactive_power_comp_factor
registers.description: [Grid code] LVRT reactive power compensation factor. Range: [0, 10.0]

registers.name: plant_lvrt_neg_seq_reactive_power_comp_factor
registers.description: [Grid code] LVRT negative-sequence reactive power compensation factor. Range: [0, 10.0]

registers.name: plant_lvrt_grid_voltage_protection_blocking
registers.description: [Grid code] LVRT grid voltage protection blocking (0: Not block, 1: Block)

registers.name: plant_hvrt_reactive_power_comp_factor
registers.description: [Grid code] HVRT reactive power compensation factor. Range: [0, 10.0]

registers.name: plant_hvrt_neg_seq_reactive_power_comp_factor
registers.description: [Grid code] HVRT negative-sequence reactive power compensation factor. Range: [0, 10.0]

registers.name: plant_hvrt_grid_voltage_protection_blocking
registers.description: [Grid code] HVRT grid voltage protection blocking (0: Not block, 1: Block)

registers.name: plant_over_freq_derating_enable
registers.description: [Grid code] Over-frequency derating enable (0: Disable, 1: Enable)

registers.name: plant_over_freq_derating_power_ramp_rate
registers.description: [Grid code] Over-frequency derating power ramp rate. Range: [0, 100.0]

registers.name: plant_over_freq_derating_trigger_freq
registers.description: [Grid code] Over-frequency derating trigger frequency. Range: [1.0*Fn, 1.2*Fn]

registers.name: plant_over_freq_derating_cutoff_freq
registers.description: [Grid code] Over-frequency derating cut-off frequency. Range: [1.0*Fn, 1.2*Fn]

registers.name: plant_under_freq_power_boost_enable
registers.description: [Grid code] Under-frequency power boost enable (0: Disable, 1: Enable)

registers.name: plant_under_freq_power_boost_power_ramp_rate
registers.description: [Grid code] Under-frequency power boost power ramp rate. Range: [0, 100.0]

registers.name: plant_under_freq_power_boost_trigger_freq
registers.description: [Grid code] Under-frequency power boost trigger frequency. Range: [0.8*Fn, 1.0*Fn]

registers.name: plant_under_freq_power_boost_cutoff_freq
registers.description: [Grid code] Under-frequency power boost cut-off frequency. Range: [0.8*Fn, 1.0*Fn]

registers.name: plant_pcc_power_factor_grid_import
registers.description: PCC Power factor adjustment (Grid import). Range: (-1, -0.8] ∪ [0.8, 1]

registers.name: plant_pcc_power_factor_grid_export
registers.description: PCC Power factor adjustment (Grid export). Range: (-1, -0.8] ∪ [0.8, 1]

registers.name: plant_grid_power_loss_lockout_alarm_clear
registers.description: Grid Power Loss Lockout Alarm Clear (1 = clear)

registers.name: inverter_max_reactive_power_adjustment_value_fed
registers.description: Max. Reactive Power Adjustment Value Fed to AC Terminal

registers.name: inverter_max_reactive_power_adjustment_value_absorbed
registers.description: Max. Reactive Power Adjustment Value Absorbed from AC Terminal

registers.name: inverter_output_type
registers.description: Output Type (0: L/N, 1: L1/L2/L3, 2: L1/L2/L3/N, 3: L1/L2/N)

registers.name: inverter_active_power_fixed_value_adjustment_feedback
registers.description: Active power fixed value adjustment feedback

registers.name: inverter_reactive_power_fixed_value_adjustment_feedback
registers.description: Reactive power fixed value adjustment feedback

registers.name: ac_charger_system_state
registers.description: System states according to IEC61851-1 definition

registers.name: ac_charger_output_current
registers.description: Charger output current ([6, X] X is the smaller value between the rated current and the AC-Charger input breaker rated current.)

registers.name: dc_charger_current_charging_capacity
registers.description: DC Charger Current Charging Capacity (Single Time)

registers.name: dc_charger_current_charging_duration
registers.description: DC Charger Current Charging Duration (Single Time)
